top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Crews, Deshaies and Handa for targeted protein degradation: induced proximity between an E3 ligase and a target, catalytic and event-driven, reproduced in many laboratories and supported by ternary-complex structures. Handa's identification of cereblon as the thalidomide target explains how monovalent glue degraders work, so the citation covers both strands of the principle. P002 (Ciulli instead of Handa, PROTAC-only) is scientifically defensible and ranked second, well above no award, because the mechanism is mature even though no degrader drug is yet approved.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Warshel, my postdoc supervisor, is not credited on this slate and I have no documented tie to Crews, Deshaies, Handa or Ciulli
